confidence_notes: Argentina's peso and inflation move prices quickly, and I could not verify July 2026 levels. No live menus or listings were checked, so these are holistic estimates. Restaurant anchors are the more grounded; accommodation is weaker. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the draft beer anchor (cocktail about two beers, wine glass slightly above one) because direct knowledge is weak. Peso examples are approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American capitals with similar tourist-facing restaurant and hostel tiers, such as Montevideo and Santiago, adjusted for Buenos Aires' volatile peso-linked pricing.
